addresses.name: g_TooltipDebug
addresses.no_signature: A global byte, not a function.
addresses.comment: Flipped by a console command that says 'Tooltip debug ENABLED' (0x4436EF). Set, ProvinceTooltip_Build adds the country's tag and id and the province's id, and shows a province that is not simulated. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincetooltip.md, section 3. The block, after the owner in brackets: '\n§YCountry tag:§! [§G' tag '§!] §Yindex:§! [§G' owner id '§!]' and '\n§YProvince id:§! [§G' id '§!]' (0x4980E7..0x49836E).
addresses.revises: The block's words were not read; they are now.
addresses.evidence: the four literals at VA 0x15BE564..0x15BE594 and the concatenation at 0x4980F3..0x4981C7, read off the listing
